title: Yamaki Hon Dashi Bonito Stock 500g
description_en: The secret behind the umami depth of Japanese cooking. Yamaki's hon dashi — made from premium bonito katsuobushi — is Japan's #1 dashi brand. One teaspoon transforms miso soup, noodle broths, tamagoyaki, and nimono dishes instantly.
description_ja: 日本料理の旨みの秘密。ヤマキの本だしは最高品質の鰹節から抽出した本格だし。みそ汁・麺つゆ・卵焼き・煮物・炒め物、小さじ1杯で料理が本格的に変わる日本一のだし。
